works.description: Working for the Order Desk (Access Networks PMO):
achievements: Designed, developed, and maintained Power BI dataflows and dashboards, including a key dashboard tracking project status and materials needs to highlight priorities and risks.
Built and optimized data pipelines using Power BI dataflows and Power Automate to trigger automatic sequential refresh, improving data reliability across the workspace.
Refactored data models and refresh schedules to reduce capacity compute consumption and pipeline failures.

Developed a data quality monitoring process to track data sources freshness and maintain data integrity, triggering automatic alerts and blocking downstream refreshes when upstream dependencies failed.
Documented data sources and pipelines to support collaboration and assess impacts of upstream/downstream changes.
Translated business requirements into actionable dashboards and reports through close collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
Automated repetitive data processes using Power Automate, increasing efficiency and reducing manual effort.
Supported ERP migration to the cloud by validating new data sources and planning report transitions, minimising business disruption.
Mentored and coached team members on data analysis, data modelling, and Power BI best practices to ensure consistency and data integrity across the workspace.
Partnered with Supply Chain stakeholders to provide insights on material requirements, process changes, and project prioritization.

works.description: Working for the Order Desk (Access Networks PMO):
achievements: Delivered accurate and timely reporting on materials needs, consumption, flow, and utilisation across projects, supporting data-driven decision making for Project Management and Supply Chain teams.

Served as Subject Matter Expert for one of the most-viewed Power BI reports in the workspace, averaging 200+ active users per 30-day period, providing self-serve visibility into materials requests and fulfillment.

Developed logic and a Power BI report to estimate expected fulfilment dates for open orders by integrating current stock, incoming purchase orders, and pending requisitions — enabling proactive Supply Chain decisions.
Extracted and loaded data from multiple data sources (flat files and SQL Server) applying transformations using Power Query (M).

works.description: Worked at the Growth department (E-commerce and Customer Loyalty):
achievements: Built a self-serve dashboard on Amazon Quicksight to efficiently communicate results of one of the company’s most important commercial tools (personalized offers for clients), delivering high-quality insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Improved process for updating monthly reports of department’s results using Excel and Powerpoint, reducing effort (from 7 hours to about 3 hours every month) and decreasing risk of manual errors by automating the update of data and charts using functions like Vlookup, Match, Index, Large, Named Ranges, etc.
Automated tasks using Python and SQL on Databricks to create and update tables which resulted in reliable and consistent data for later analysis.
Built modular data structures and models in data marts using dbt for easy consumption ensuring best practices for data modeling and reporting workflows.

works.description: Worked at the Sales & Marketing department:
achievements: Conducted the implementation of the company's on-premises Data Warehouse to advance data analytics. Evaluated business requirements from different internal stakeholders in the company, with a main focus on the ​​Sales & Marketing department. The project was coordinated with the IT department and an external consulting firm. It reduced the time to generate insights as well as freed BI analysts from spending days preparing reports.
Answered ad hoc requests using Power BI and developing dashboards which allowed senior management to make timely and better decisions.
Empowered and provided direction and training to end-users to perform their own analysis, build reports and help them with the decision making process.

Found sales opportunities in the competition through high-level analysis of hotels’ reports and implementation of TravelClick business intelligence solutions (Rate360 and Agency360) to help the sales team take more assertive actions while negotiating with companies’ travel managers or travel agencies.
Assisted in exploring locations and sales opportunities for new hotels which resulted in better performance and increased bookings before the hotels’ opening.

works.description: Worked at the Sales & Marketing department:
achievements: Provided insight to sales teams and managers by performing analysis of KPIs using Excel and preparing presentations in PowerPoint to support data-driven decisions.

Forecasted sales revenue by considering internal and external factors (economic conditions and outlook, holidays, new competitors, new hotels, investments) to help senior executives make assertive decisions.
Assisted the budgeting process to help drive the strategies of the Sales and Marketing department for the following year.
